title: Web API
description: Design, build, and consume RESTful Web APIs in ASP.NET Core — from HTTP fundamentals to real-world client integration.
longDescription: This module provides a complete, end-to-end learning path for Web APIs in ASP.NET Core. You begin by understanding REST principles and HTTP verbs, then build a production-style API using controllers and attribute routing. You will test endpoints with Postman and curl before consuming the API from JavaScript (XHR), jQuery, and an ASP.NET Core MVC application using HttpClient. The module also covers API key security, file uploads, XML format negotiation, and the [FormatFilter] attribute.
whatYouLearn: Explain REST principles, HTTP verbs, and status codes.
Design resource-based URL structures for a Web API.
Build a RESTful Web API with [ApiController], ControllerBase, and attribute routing.
Implement all CRUD operations: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.
Test API endpoints using Postman and curl.
Consume APIs from JavaScript using XMLHttpRequest (XHR).
Consume APIs from ASP.NET Core using HttpClient and async/await.
Secure API write operations with API key headers.
Upload files via multipart/form-data using IFormFile and FormData.
Serve and consume XML responses using [Produces] and [Consumes].
Enable CORS so browsers can call cross-origin APIs.
